answer.question: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in Semiconductor, and what evidence supports each opportunity? Please identify opportunities specifically for signaling/non-signaling testers (e.g., CMX500, CMW, CMP180/200 or similar) in semiconductor, rank strongest opportunities, and cite Raw evidence for each.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：新聞稿發布者與測試解決方案供應商。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：frontmatter author 與 R&S registered trademark 所屬公司名。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：R&D single-box signaling tester；本來源新增 Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality、WLAN offloading、N3IWF 與 POLQA voice quality measurement 的 PR 語境。
- [[R&S CMP180]]：production / R&D non-signaling tester；本來源宣稱支援 Wi-Fi 6E、Wi-Fi 7、5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz、bandwidths up to 500 MHz，並展示 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback。
- [[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]]：本來源的主題概念，區分 CMX500 R&D signaling 與 CMP180 production non-signaling 測試。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]：本來源描述的 CMX500 single-box interworking / voice continuity 測試情境。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]：來源列出 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM、低延遲與 high throughput。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]]：來源稱 yet-to-be-defined，且 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion；CMP180 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate。
- [[MLO]]：Wi-Fi 7 key feature，使 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 變重要。
- [[N3IWF]]：Non-3GPP Interworking Function gateway；來源稱 newly integrated in R&S CMX500。
- [[POLQA]]：來源稱 R&S CMX500 integrated POLQA voice quality measurement function 可用於 Voice over WLAN applications。
- [[MWC 2024]]：展示場合。
- [[Christian Mokry]]：Press & media contact。

passages.text:
Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁已依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 記錄 CMX500 的 WLAN signaling / measurement options；本來源補充的是 2024 MWC PR / solution demonstration 語境，不提供正式 option code、software version 或硬體 BOM。
- 既有 [[R&S CMP180]] 頁已依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 記錄 8 GHz frequency extension 與 500 MHz bandwidth options；本來源補充 MWC 2024 對 Wi‑Fi 7 production testing 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback demonstration 的 positioning。
- 既有 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 主要來自 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR；本來源不描述 OTA chamber，而是 R&S own CMX500 / CMP180 single-box R&D / production workflow。
- 既有 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 頁依較晚的 R&S / Broadcom PR 記錄 Wi-Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth；本來源較早期說 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，且 480 MHz waveform 是 potential candidate，因此需在 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 並列而不調和。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

CMX500 Callbox › UI 與 automation

- live views。

- Sequencer。
- Log analysis。
- One-click RF testing。

在 RF pre-conformance 脈絡中，來源稱可 quick switch from manual to automated pre-conformance，且使用 same technology specific license，並指向 [[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 與 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S CMP200 › CMP200 interfaces
- Rear panel remote control：LAN Ethernet RJ-45，1000 Mbps；USB device USB 3.0 type B。
- Rear panel trigger：Trig A、Trig B，2 × BNC，3.3 V TTL。
- Rear panel further interfaces：2 × USB 2.0、2 × USB 3.0 type A、DVI-D、DisplayPort。
- Front panel further interfaces：2 × USB 2.0、1 × USB 3.0 type A。
- Front panel sensor interfaces：Sensor 1、Sensor 2、Sensor 3，8-pin socket，供 [[R&S NRPMx]] OTA power sensors。
- Sensor port：front panel，8-pin socket，供 [[R&S NRPx]] power sensors。
- Display：1.9-inch e-paper TFT EPD black/white，144 × 128 pixel。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

以上均為待讀線索，不新增本頁的技術規格主張。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 與 CMW-KA096 的關係
[[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]] 將 [[R&S CMW-KA096]]（for CMWPC；NGECALL APPL）列為 allowed license swap 的 CMW500 source keycode，對應到 [[R&S CMX-KA098]]（for CMWPC；Application test IMS NGeCALL）。

[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 是 [[R&S CMW500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] / [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 的 Oct. 2024 NGeCall over LTE capability list；[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 則是 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 CMX-KA098 / [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 的 NGeCall over NR/LTE capability list。兩者是不同平台 / option 組合，不應合併為同一 option。

Rohde & Schwarz will display its [R&S CMX500](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-network-emulator/cmx500-5g-one-box-signaling-tester_63493-601282.html "CMX500") multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester at MWC 2024 with newly added Wi-Fi 7 testing capabilities. With this functionality, the one-box tester allows R&D engineers of wireless devices to comprehensively test their design’s operation in cellular and non-cellular standards of the latest generation in a single instrument setup. In addition to this, the [R&S CMP180](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-rf-analyzer-generator/cmp180-radio-communication-tester_63493-1081280.html "CMP180") radio communication tester will verify a signal waveform of 480 MHz bandwidth in loopback mode, attesting to be a future-proof solution for users in R&D and production, even beyond the requirements of Wi-Fi 7.

In addition to this, the [R&S CMP180](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-rf-analyzer-generator/cmp180-radio-communication-tester_63493-1081280.html "CMP180") radio communication tester will verify a signal waveform of 480 MHz bandwidth in loopback mode, attesting to be a future-proof solution for users in R&D and production, even beyond the requirements of Wi-Fi 7.
